criteria.title: Applicant must not be a Vogon (Section 3)
Flight readiness or valid exemption (Sections 4 & 6)
criteria.rule_text:
OR(
  ( AND space.crew.flight_hours is at least 500 AND space.crew.has_pilot_license equals true),
  ( AND space.crew.age is at least 60 AND space.mission.type is one of "suborbital" or "lunar"),
  space.crew.flight_hours is at least 1000
)

criteria.title: Medical certificate — Route A: GAA examination (Section 5(1)(a))
Medical certificate — Route B: approved provider (Section 5(1)(b))
Medical certificate must be within validity period (Section 5A)
Radiation protection certificate required for orbital missions (Section 7)
criteria.rule_text: IF space.mission.type equals "orbital" THEN space.crew.has_radiation_cert equals true

criteria.title: Vessel propulsion must be an approved type (Section 8)
criteria.rule_text: space.vessel.propulsion_type is one of "Infinite Improbability Drive", "Bistromathics", or "Heart of Gold Special"
